trigger: /status is dispatched while should_prefetch_rate_limits() is true
behaviour: A status card is added to history at once with its Limits row in the refreshing state, and a rate-limit read is started for that card.
backend_effect: AppEvent::RefreshRateLimits with origin StatusCommand{request_id}; request_id from next_status_refresh_request_id (wrapping add).
notes: StatusCommand starts are never deduplicated (app/rate_limit_refresh.rs:56-60 gates Periodic only).

trigger: /status is dispatched while should_prefetch_rate_limits() is false
precondition: no ChatGPT account or requires_openai_auth false
behaviour: The card is added at once with refreshing off and no request id, so no read is started.

trigger: add_status_output creates a card
behaviour: The card reserves the Billed-tokens label width, is primed with the chat's current thread estimate, and a usage request is made for this card.
backend_effect: AppEvent::RefreshThreadUsage{thread_id, request_id} unless a request is already pending.
notes: thread_usage_is_available (chatwidget/thread_usage.rs:384-397) and request_thread_usage are not candidates. The primed estimate is read before any thread-change clear: see TU-23.

trigger: add_status_output creates a card
behaviour: The card has no thread-usage rows and no label reservation, and no usage request is made.

trigger: /status is run while a task is running
behaviour: /status is available during a running task: it sits in the arm of available_during_task that returns true.
oracle: slash_command.rs:274-309 (Status at 287, in the true arm ending at 309)
notes: not a candidate: slash_command.rs availability; arm placement checked by grep: 274-309 returns true.

trigger: the Status command is listed
behaviour: Its description reads 'show current session configuration and token usage'.
notes: not a candidate: description string.

trigger: a status card is rendered at width W
behaviour: No lines are produced at width zero.
notes: Zero-width case untested.

trigger: a status card is rendered at width W
behaviour: The first line is the Codex title with the field indent (the indent is dropped when the available width is below the indent length plus 2), then a blank line.
notes: Title text comes from codex_title (history_cell/session.rs:44, not a candidate).

trigger: the card's display_lines is called at width W
behaviour: The view hook returns content_lines(W) for the card, so every layout rule below applies at the requested width.
notes: View hook for the Arc<StatusHistoryCell> impl; raw and display paths are separate (raw_lines at 975-977).

trigger: content_lines builds the labels for a card
behaviour: The value column starts after the longest label present plus padding; the label set holds every label the card may show, including labels of rows then omitted, and labels are deduplicated in first-insert order.
notes: Token usage is pushed at card.rs:819 even for ChatGPT accounts whose row is hidden, so the hidden label still widens the column (risk).

trigger: a field line is formatted
behaviour: The label is written as indent, label, colon and padding so the value starts at the shared value column; continuation lines are indented to that column.
notes: value_offset = 2 + label width + 1 + 2 (format.rs:28).

trigger: a value is wider than its column
behaviour: The value is word-wrapped to the available width with continuation lines at the value column; a line still too wide after wrapping is wrapped again without the continuation indent.
notes: Word splitting is disabled (NoHyphenation).

trigger: a value is wrapped with value width zero
behaviour: Continuation lines use the outer indent instead of the value column.
notes: Untested.

trigger: content_lines builds the Model row
behaviour: The Model row shows the model name followed by a parenthesised list: 'reasoning <effort lowercased>' and 'summaries <value>' ('summaries off' for none or off), omitted when empty.
notes: Both entries exist only for the Responses wire API (card.rs:321-325); the summaries entry also needs no remote connection (card.rs:326-334). compose_model_display is not a candidate.

trigger: add_status_output builds the card
behaviour: The reasoning effort shown is the status override, else the configured effort, else the selected model's catalog default, else 'none'.

trigger: add_status_output builds the card
precondition: a thread exists and the provider id is non-blank
behaviour: A Model provider row appears under Model only in that case.

trigger: content_lines builds the Directory row
behaviour: The Directory row shows the working directory with the home prefix shortened to '~' and is never truncated.
notes: The snapshots show a sanitized placeholder (sanitize_directory, S19-C028). The copy field 'Directory' is the raw cwd (CP-2).

trigger: compose_agents_summary runs at card creation
behaviour: Each instruction file is named relative to the cwd (its file name in the cwd, '../' steps for ancestors, the stripped path for other descendants, otherwise the absolute path), joined by ', ', and '<none>' when there are none.
notes: Inline snapshots at helpers.rs:321 and 323 (S19-C142, S19-C143).

trigger: an instruction path has a non-native convention or cannot be made absolute
behaviour: That path is shown as its full inferred native string rather than a relative name.
notes: helpers.rs:41-42 carries a TODO that this summary is not yet aligned with other foreign-path displays.

trigger: permissions label is built
precondition: the active permission profile id is the built-in read-only profile
behaviour: The label is 'Read Only (<approval>)', or 'Read Only with network access (<approval>)' when the sandbox text says network is enabled.
notes: status_permissions_label (card.rs:666) is not a candidate.

trigger: permissions label is built
precondition: the active permission profile id is the built-in workspace profile and the sandbox is 'workspace' or 'workspace with network access'
behaviour: The label is 'Workspace[ [extra roots]] (<approval>)' or 'Workspace with network access[ [extra roots]] (<approval>)'.

trigger: permissions label is built
precondition: the active profile is the built-in danger-full-access id and the permission profile is Disabled
behaviour: The label is 'Full Access' when the approval policy is Never, else 'No Sandbox (<approval>)'.
notes: Test name-level only.

trigger: permissions label is built
precondition: the active profile is another (named or user-defined) id
behaviour: The label is 'Profile <id> (<sandbox with extra roots>, <approval>)'.

trigger: permissions label is built
behaviour: The label is 'Read Only (<approval>)' for a read-only sandbox; 'Workspace[ [extra roots]] (<approval>)' for on-request approval with a workspace sandbox; 'Full Access' for Never with a disabled profile; otherwise 'Custom (<sandbox>, <approval>)'.
notes: Snapshot shows 'Custom (workspace with network access, Ask for approval)'.

trigger: the effective workspace roots include a root other than the cwd
behaviour: A ' [root, root]' suffix (native paths of the extra roots) is added to Workspace labels and to the sandbox text of profile and custom labels.

trigger: the sandbox text of the permission profile is summarised
behaviour: The sandbox word is 'read-only' or 'read-only with network access', 'workspace' or 'workspace with network access', 'custom permissions with network access' for that case, else the summary as is.
notes: status_permission_summary is not a candidate.

trigger: the approval label is built
behaviour: The label is 'Approve for me' when the reviewer is auto-review and 'Ask for approval' when the user reviews; other policies show the configured approval string.
notes: status_approval_label is not a candidate.

trigger: content_lines builds the Server row
precondition: a remote connection status exists (not the embedded target)
behaviour: The row shows 'Local background server' for a local daemon; otherwise the address followed by the version in parentheses, both as preformatted by remote_connection_status_value; a blank line follows.
notes: is_managed_daemon (S19-C060) is read by app/daemon_menu.rs, startup.rs and reconnect.rs, not by the card. The embedded target gives no row (remote_connection_status_value returns None, remote_connection.rs:22-60); the 'Cloud' and 'unknown' wording is set there, not in the card.

trigger: a websocket or unix endpoint is shown as the server address
precondition: remote endpoint, not embedded or cloud
behaviour: A websocket address is shown after sanitization (sanitized_websocket_url); other endpoint kinds show the address as set by remote_connection_status_value.
notes: Sanitizer fallback text not read.

trigger: content_lines builds the Account row
behaviour: The Account row shows 'email (plan)', 'email', 'plan' or 'ChatGPT' for ChatGPT accounts, and 'API key configured (run codex login to use ChatGPT)' for API-key accounts.
notes: Plan labels come from plan_type_display_name (helpers.rs:100-104, S19-C018) upstream; Account display construction upstream was not read.

trigger: content_lines builds the ChatGPT workspace row
precondition: a ChatGPT account has a workspace
behaviour: A 'ChatGPT workspace' row follows Account; it is absent for API-key accounts and for accounts without a workspace.
notes: The card checks only is_some. A first-party-only filter mentioned in an earlier note is not in the card code; any upstream filter was not read.

trigger: content_lines builds the Thread name row
behaviour: A 'Thread name' row shows the name.

trigger: content_lines builds the Session row
behaviour: A 'Session' row shows the thread id.

trigger: content_lines builds the Forked from row
precondition: a session id and a forked-from source both exist
behaviour: A 'Forked from' row follows Session.

trigger: content_lines builds the Collaboration mode row
behaviour: A 'Collaboration mode' row appears between Thread name and Session.

trigger: content_lines builds the Token usage row
precondition: the account is a ChatGPT account
behaviour: No Token usage row is shown; API-key and no-account cards show it.
notes: Test name-level. The label is still in the label set (card.rs:819).

trigger: the Token usage row is shown
behaviour: The row reads '<total> total  (<input> input + <output> output)', compact-formatted; total is non-cached input plus output, so cached input is excluded.
notes: The gap before '(' is two spaces, from the span order.

trigger: token totals are formatted for the card
precondition: a count is passed to format_tokens_compact
behaviour: Values under 1000 print as integers; from 1000 they are scaled to K, M, B or T with two decimals below 10, one below 100 and none above, with trailing zeros removed; a value that would round to 1000 moves up a unit.
notes: No test in the status test list asserts this function directly.

trigger: the Context window row is built
precondition: context window known (token info or config window)
behaviour:
The row reads '

% left ( used / )': P is the window share left after subtracting a 12000-token baseline (0 when the window is at most 12000); used is the last turn's total tokens; window is compact-formatted.
notes: The percent uses the baseline; the displayed used count is the raw total (token_usage.rs:52-56 / card.rs:387).

trigger: the Context window row is built
behaviour: No Context window row and no label.
notes: Untested: token info present with no model window.

trigger: a Window limit row is shown
behaviour: A 20-cell bar is drawn with round(remaining × 20 / 100) filled cells, followed by '<R>% left' with R rounded to a whole percent, where remaining is clamp(100 − used, 0, 100).
notes: Snapshot shows '[██████████████░░░░░░] 68% left' for remaining 68.

trigger: the bar and summary do not fit the value width
precondition: bar plus space plus summary is wider than the value width
behaviour: Only '<R>% left' is shown, so the reset text keeps room.
notes: Untested by the candidate list.

trigger: a Window row has a reset time
precondition: the whole line fits the available width
behaviour: '(resets <T>)' stays on the value line after a space.

trigger: a Window row has a reset time
behaviour: The value line stays alone and the reset text wraps onto continuation lines without breaking words.
notes: Untested in detail.

trigger: a reset time is formatted
precondition: the reset is on the capture date or another day
behaviour: The time uses the clock preference; on a different date it reads '<time> on <D Mon>'.

trigger: a window row has details
behaviour: The details wrap below the value under the value column.

trigger: a Text row is shown
behaviour: The row shows 'label: text' on one line; empty text (a group heading) shows the label alone.

trigger: the rate limit state is Available
behaviour: Rows render without a Warning or Limits row, and the refreshing flag has no visible effect on them.
notes: Name/assertion mismatch: the test name says a refreshing notice is shown, but its snapshot has none.

trigger: the rate limit state is Stale
precondition: a contributing snapshot or monthly limit is older than 15 minutes; refreshing
behaviour: Rows render, then a 'Warning:' row reads 'limits may be stale - run /status again shortly.'
notes: No test or snapshot covers the refreshing variant.

trigger: the rate limit state is Stale
behaviour: Rows render, then a 'Warning:' row reads 'limits may be stale - start new turn to refresh.'

trigger: rate limit state is composed
precondition: snapshot captured_at older than 15 minutes at compose time, or a monthly limit captured_at older
behaviour: The state is Stale; the threshold is strictly greater than 15 minutes and uses the capture time, which is ingestion time on the local clock.
notes: Staleness counts only snapshots that contribute rows (rate_limits.rs:243-250).

trigger: a snapshot has no windows, no credits row and no monthly limit
behaviour: The snapshot contributes no heading, no row and no staleness.
notes: Untested.

trigger: rate limit state is composed
precondition: every snapshot is metadata-only, so no rows remain
behaviour: The state is Unavailable, and the Limits row reads 'not available for this account' even while refreshing.

trigger: the rate limit state is Available with no rows
behaviour: Would read 'Limits: not available for this account'.
notes: Unreachable: compose returns Unavailable for empty rows (rate_limits.rs:359-360) and no other code builds Available(empty). Dead branch.

trigger: the rate limit state is Missing and a refresh is pending
behaviour: The Limits row reads 'refresh requested; run /status again shortly.'
notes: Tested via the overlay test only.

trigger: the rate limit state is Missing
behaviour: The Limits row reads 'data not available yet'.

trigger: the card's label set is built
precondition: rate limit state is Stale, Unavailable or Missing
behaviour: The label set gains 'Warning' for Stale and 'Limits' for Unavailable or Missing, which can widen the value column.
notes: Width effect untested.

trigger: rate limit snapshots are composed
behaviour: Snapshots whose limit name is 'codex' are listed first; the others keep input order.

trigger: a snapshot's limit name is not 'codex' and it has windows
behaviour: A heading row '<model display name> limit' with empty text is added, unless exactly one window exists; then that window's row is labelled '<name> <window> limit' with no heading.
notes: Display name via model_catalog::model_display_name (model_catalog.rs:18), not read.

trigger: a window row is labelled
precondition: window length in minutes is known or unknown
behaviour: The label comes from the length in minutes, capitalised; an unknown length falls back to the generic primary or secondary label.
notes: limit_label_for_window lives outside the status module (not a candidate); body not read in full.

trigger: the credits snapshot is unlimited
behaviour: A 'Credits: Unlimited' row appears regardless of has_credits.

trigger: the credits snapshot is not unlimited
behaviour: No Credits row.
notes: Test name-level.

trigger: the credits snapshot has has_credits true
behaviour: The row reads '<N> credits' when the balance parses to a positive whole or rounded number, otherwise 'Available' (zero, negative or unparseable balances).

trigger: the snapshot has an individual (monthly) limit
precondition: used and limit parse as finite non-negative numbers
behaviour: A 'Monthly credit limit' row shows the bar of 100 − remaining percent and reset time; detail reads '<used> of <limit> credits used' with rounded, thousands-separated amounts.

trigger: the snapshot has an individual limit with an unparseable or negative used or limit
behaviour: The whole monthly limit is dropped: no row and no staleness.
notes: Untested.

trigger: a rate-limit refresh starts
behaviour: The start is never deduplicated and takes neither the periodic nor the recovery hold.
notes: not a candidate: rate_limit_refresh.rs start.

trigger: a rate-limit read completes
precondition: request is a generation mismatch, older than the applied id, or Failed
behaviour: The result is ignored (not applied) and does not change the applied id.
notes: not a candidate. Ignore branch at 122-127.

trigger: a StatusCommand read completes successfully
behaviour: Its snapshots are cached (AccountUsage) and the card is updated in place: the card takes the whole cache, not only these snapshots, and refreshing clears.
notes: card.rs:99 finish_rate_limit_refresh is not a candidate.

trigger: a StatusCommand read completes successfully
precondition: the result is not accepted (ignored by the state machine)
behaviour: Snapshots are not cached; the card redraws from the existing cache and refreshing clears.
notes: Untested.

trigger: a StatusCommand read fails
behaviour: The card clears refreshing and shows the existing cache (or 'data not available yet' when there is none); the cache is not cleared.
notes: Untested.

trigger: a StatusCommand read is in flight
behaviour: The card keeps 'refresh requested; run /status again shortly.' with no TUI timeout: the StatusCommand arm awaits the request without a timeout, unlike the reset-request origins.
notes: Unclear: a read that never returns leaves the card refreshing; not a candidate.

trigger: a status refresh result arrives for a request id no longer in the refreshing list
precondition: the card was drained by an account change or the request is unknown
behaviour: The result is dropped: snapshots are not cached and no card is updated.

trigger: two /status refreshes are in flight
behaviour: Each result updates only the card with its request id (swap_remove); other cards keep refreshing.

trigger: account state is updated
behaviour: Every refreshing card is finished with no snapshots, so it reads 'data not available yet' and is no longer refreshing; the thread-usage state is cleared.
notes: settings.rs:update_account_state is not a candidate.

trigger: an AccountUsage rate-limit snapshot arrives
behaviour: It is written to the cache keyed by limit id; rolling updates are not written.
notes: not a candidate: the cache write.

trigger: a rolling rate-limit update arrives
behaviour: It drives warnings and recovery but never changes a status card.
notes: not a candidate.

trigger: on_rate_limit_snapshot(None) is called
behaviour: Clears the cache, quota plan and reached flags.
notes: Dead path: grep finds no caller passing None.

trigger: a codex-bucket snapshot with a plan arrives
precondition: plan differs from the current plan
behaviour: The quota plan is set and billing plan and status surfaces refresh.
notes: not a candidate.

trigger: a thread-usage surface or request is considered
precondition: has_codex_backend_auth, feature not disabled, thread id set, and plan is Ent26, Business, EnterpriseCbpUsageBased or EnterpriseCbpAutomation
behaviour: Thread usage is requested, shown and settled only for these plans.
notes: thread_usage_is_available is not a candidate.

trigger: the Thread usage row is built
precondition: estimate exists and plan is Ent26
behaviour: Only 'Thread usage: <usd>' appears (native USD); no credits, breakdowns or billed tokens; no row when there is no USD.
notes: Labels for breakdowns are still pushed for Ent26 (see TU-11).

trigger: the Thread usage row is built
precondition: estimate exists and plan is not Ent26
behaviour: The row reads '<credits> credits' and appends ' · <usd>' when a USD value exists.

trigger: breakdown lines are built
precondition: groups produce a value for the dimension
behaviour: '  Models', '  Reasoning' and '  Speed' rows list 'name pct%' entries, wrapped under the value column; a dimension with no value is omitted.

trigger: breakdown values are grouped
behaviour: That group is skipped; totals are keyed by name ('Other' when missing) and each percent is the half-up share of total credits (0 when the total is not positive).
notes: Percent formula at thread_usage.rs:275-281.

trigger: breakdown entries are ordered
precondition: dimension is Model, Reasoning or Speed
behaviour: Models sort by credits descending then name; Reasoning and Speed follow a fixed order, unknown names last, then by name.

trigger: a reasoning or speed name is shown
behaviour: Reasoning reads none→None, minimal→Minimal, low→Light, medium→Medium, high→High, xhigh→Extra High, max→Max, ultra→Ultra; Speed reads fast→Fast mode, ultrafast→Ultrafast, standard→Standard; unknown names pass through.
notes: Mapping not verified line by line.

trigger: a model name is shown in breakdowns
behaviour: The name goes through the catalog display name.

trigger: a credit amount is formatted
behaviour: Credits are shown in 1e6 units with T, B, M or K suffixes above their thresholds and one decimal, rounded half up, with '.0' dropped.

trigger: a USD amount is formatted
behaviour: A negative amount shows nothing; 0 < micros < 100 shows '~$0.' with six digits; below 10000 shows four digits rounded; otherwise '~$D.CC' rounded to cents (0 reads '~$0.00').
notes: No direct test in the candidate list.

trigger: the Billed tokens row is built
precondition: groups are non-empty and some input or output sum is present
behaviour: The row reads '<in> input (<cached> cached) + <out> output', cached shown only with input, '+' only when both parts exist.
notes: not a candidate: token sums in thread_usage.rs:146-177.

trigger: the thread-usage label set is built
behaviour: 'Thread usage' is always added; Models, Reasoning and Speed labels are added when groups exist, even for Ent26, widening the column without a visible row (risk); Billed tokens is added when reserved or when groups carry tokens.
notes: Risk: Ent26 cards get breakdown label widths that show no rows.

trigger: a /status card is created while thread usage is available
behaviour: The Billed-tokens width is reserved before the fetch so the label column does not shift when data arrives; no placeholder row is shown.
notes: Reservation tested only indirectly.

trigger: a usage fetch returns Available for the pending request
behaviour: The estimate is replaced and, when no settlement is pending, every card handle is updated and released.
notes: finish_thread_usage_refresh is not a candidate.

trigger: a usage fetch returns Available with zero credits or zero USD after a positive value
precondition: the previous estimate had a positive value
behaviour: The previous positive value (and breakdown groups, when the new groups are empty) is kept.

trigger: a usage fetch returns Disabled
behaviour: The feature is marked disabled, the estimate is cleared, the cards are updated and usage is not requested again.
notes: Untested.

trigger: a usage fetch returns Available for another thread
behaviour: A warning is logged, nothing is updated, and a retry is scheduled.
notes: Untested.

trigger: a usage fetch fails
precondition: the pending request matches and the thread is selected
behaviour: A retry is scheduled after 5, 15 and 60 seconds, then no more; a success resets the attempt count.
backend_effect: RefreshThreadUsage again when the timer fires
notes: Retry constants at thread_usage.rs:27-29.

trigger: a usage fetch takes longer than the timeout
behaviour: The fetch is cut at 65 seconds and handled as a failure.
notes: not a candidate.

trigger: a turn completes and thread usage is selected and available
behaviour: The settlement baseline is set to the current credits and cost, the attempt count resets, and a usage read is requested.

trigger: a settlement read is due
precondition: the estimate has not yet passed the baseline
behaviour: The next re-read follows after 15, 60, then 120 seconds; when the credits (and USD where shown) exceed the baseline, the baseline and handles are released.
notes: Constants at thread_usage.rs:22-26.

trigger: the settlement attempts are exhausted
behaviour: The baseline is cleared and the card keeps its last shown estimate.

trigger: a usage result arrives for a request or thread no longer pending
behaviour: It is ignored: nothing is updated and no retry is scheduled.

trigger: the plan changes
behaviour: Pending /status cards reserve the label width and request usage; when the plan is not billable the thread-usage state is cleared.

trigger: a thread is entered and usage state belongs to another thread
behaviour: The usage state is cleared and re-keyed to the new thread before any request.

trigger: a /status card is created on a thread whose usage state belongs to another thread
behaviour: The card is primed with the previous thread's estimate before the state is cleared, so it may show that estimate until a fresh result arrives.
notes: Unclear: order of estimated_thread_usage() and the clear at request_thread_usage_for_status; not confirmed by a test.

trigger: the copy picker offers Whole status
precondition: a status card was the last copy source
behaviour: Whole status copies the card's copy_text: content at maximum width, each line trailing-trimmed, joined by newlines, outer whitespace trimmed; it reflects the card at copy time.
notes: The copy test is in chatwidget/tests/slash_commands.rs (~1862-1900), not re-read.

trigger: a /status card is created
behaviour: The copy fields are captured at /status time: Model (the raw model slug, not the display name), Directory (the raw cwd), Thread name when non-empty, and Session ID when a thread exists.
notes: Model copy uses selected_model() while the card shows status_model_display_name() (status_controls.rs:266).

trigger: a new /status card replaces the copy source
behaviour: Only the latest status card's copy source is kept.

trigger: raw lines are needed for raw mode
behaviour: raw_lines is display_lines at maximum width with plain hyperlinks.
notes: Raw-mode dispatch at history_cell/mod.rs:290-296 not re-read in full.

trigger: display hyperlinks are built
behaviour: Each underlined span (the usage URL, the only underlined span) carries a web hyperlink to https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage; without the flag, hyperlinks are plain.

trigger: transcript hyperlinks are built
behaviour: They equal the display hyperlinks.

trigger: the card renders
behaviour: A 'Visit <URL> for up-to-date' line and 'information on rate limits and credits' follow the title, wrapped with ASCII-space word separators and no hyphenation, then a blank line; the block is hidden when the flag is false.
notes: The hidden case is not covered by the candidate tests.

trigger: /status is dispatched and no prefetch applies in a non-ChatGPT state
behaviour: The card is created with refreshing off and no request, so its Limits row shows the cached state at render time.
notes: Duplicate-looking with H-02 for the Limits row; kept for the cache state.
